description: Dentistry explores how teeth work and how to keep them healthy: tooth structure and X-rays, decay and gum disease, a dental visit, fluoride and whole-body health, hands-on projects, and careers in dentistry.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Teeth and X-rays
requirements.summary: Studying dental X-rays and drawing and labeling a tooth.

requirements.title: Decay and gum disease
requirements.summary: Causes of tooth decay and gum disease, mouth guards, and the effects of tobacco.

requirements.title: Visiting a dentist
requirements.summary: Visiting a dental office and learning how the team works.

requirements.title: Dental options
requirements.summary: Two options, such as identifying dental instruments or tracking your diet.

requirements.title: Fluoride and health
requirements.summary: How fluoride helps teeth and how oral health connects to overall health.

requirements.title: Dental projects
requirements.summary: Two projects, such as a model tooth, a poster or an article.

requirements.title: Dental careers
requirements.summary: Researching dental careers and exploring one in depth.
